observations.evidence: which days do the classes meet
observations.observation_es: Después de «Could you tell me» la pregunta va en orden de afirmación, sin «do».
observations.suggestion_es: Escribe «Could you tell me which days the classes meet?».

observations.evidence: how much does the course cost per month
observations.observation_es: En una pregunta indirecta no se usa «does»: el verbo lleva -s.
observations.suggestion_es: Escribe «I would like to know how much the course costs per month.»
